versions.changelog: Companion playbook: brand, research archive, memory, and receipt-bound briefs. Agents read and draft; they never spend. You approve every cut.

Initial release of the eonik AI Agent Skill.

- Enables full integration with the eonik Intelligence Engine for performance marketing tasks.
- Supports creative auditing, trend discovery, genome and fatigue analysis, creative brief generation, and automated campaign deployment via a local CLI.
- Provides clear execution instructions and formatting guidelines for presenting insights.
- Requires the EONIK_API_KEY environment variable for operation.
- Designed for end-to-end campaign management on platforms like Meta, TikTok, and Google.
